description:
Job Details: 
 Location: Kirksville, MO 
 Job Title: Process Developer 
 Duration: 15 + Months (Could go beyond) 
 
 Scope: Hands-on / In-plant resource to help in the commissioning and qualification of new processing lines and equipment in a meat manufacturing facility that produces consumer packaged goods 
 Abilities 
 o Quickly learn and understand key parameters of unit processes within the production line 
 o Experiment with and translate how adjustments to processing parameters affect finished product quality attributes 
 o Provide direction and instructions to line technicians in order to complete key aspects of technical testing plans (data collection, control schemes, etc) 
 o Analyze and interpret data in real-time to guide process adjustments 
 o Troubleshoot equipment and processing issues on the plant floor 
 o Effectively communicate learnings, challenges, and risks to multi-disciplinary team 
 o Incorporate feedback/input from all levels (plant floor, engineers, managers) to come to optimal processing parameters 
 
 o Quickly learn and understand general parameters of processes within the production line 
 o Complete key aspects of technical testing plans (data collection, control schemes, etc) 
 o Work under the direction of R&D Process Leads and Unit operation technical experts 
 o Troubleshoot equipment and processing issues on the plant floor 
 o Effectively communicate learnings, challenges, and risks to multi-disciplinary team 
 o Incorporate feedback/input from all levels (plant floor, engineers, managers) 
 
 Additional General/Technical Skills: 

 • Able to work well in a team environment 
 • Strong communication (written / verbal) and influencing skills 
 • Manage multiple assignments/tasks concurrently 
 • Strong organization, leadership, and project management skills 
 • Commercialization & Plant Operations Experience 
 • Commercialization & Plant Trial Experience 
 Will be creating Commissioning guides 
 

 
 Primary location – October – march – Kirksville, MO 
 April to end 2017 - Davenport, IA 
 

 Requirements: 
 BS degree in Engineering 
 5+ years engineering experience 
 o 4-year degree in engineering, food science, or related field preferred 
 o Ability to travel 80% to Midwest locations 
 
 
 Preferences: 
 o Experience with CPG companies, meat processing, and in-plant commercialization 
 o Plant floor experience highly preferred 
 o Must have advanced Excel skills – analyzing, graphing charts, v-look ups. 
 o This position will accommodate 24 hour coverage, candidates will split time or rotate 1st 8AM-8PM and or 2nd shift 8PM -8AM 
 
 Demonstrated ability and potential to progress to a leadership position within the organization 
 commissioning of new product lines and relocating existing product lines. 
 Must have experience working in a plant environment (CPG and plant floor experience strongly preferred) 

 To know more about this position, please contact:
